evals.prompt: Give me TypeScript code to do a simple chat with gpt-4o-mini using @sap-ai-sdk
evals.expected_output: Agent asks clarifying questions if needed, then produces working TypeScript code using @sap-ai-sdk/orchestration with OrchestrationClient, including the correct npm install command and a credential setup comment.
assertions: Generated code uses @sap-ai-sdk/orchestration (not a generic OpenAI client)
Code imports OrchestrationClient from @sap-ai-sdk/orchestration
Install command uses npm install @sap-ai-sdk/orchestration
Code includes a comment about aicore configure or credential setup
Code calls chatCompletion() or equivalent and prints the response

evals.prompt: Write TypeScript to chat with an orchestration model using @sap-ai-sdk. Use the current SDK config shape.
evals.expected_output: Agent produces v2 OrchestrationClient code using the promptTemplating config shape, not the legacy llm/templating shape.
assertions: Config uses promptTemplating with a nested model: { name: ... }
Config does NOT use the v1 shape llm: { model_name } or a top-level templating: { template } key
Model params (if any) are under model.params (e.g. temperature, max_tokens), not model_params
Response content is read via getContent()

evals.prompt: Show me how to stream a chat completion token-by-token with @sap-ai-sdk/orchestration in TypeScript.
evals.expected_output: Agent produces streaming code that consumes response.stream as an async iterable and prints deltas via getDeltaContent().
assertions: Code calls client.stream(...) and iterates response.stream with a for await...of loop
Code does NOT use an EventEmitter pattern like stream.stream.on('data', ...)
Each chunk's text is read via getDeltaContent()
Install command uses npm install @sap-ai-sdk/orchestration

evals.prompt: I want to use an Anthropic Claude model through SAP orchestration in Node.js/TypeScript. Give me a starter.
evals.expected_output: Agent produces OrchestrationClient v2 code with an Anthropic Claude model name in promptTemplating.model.name.
assertions: model.name is an orchestration model identifier for Claude (e.g. anthropic--claude-4.5-haiku)
Config uses the v2 promptTemplating shape
Code prints the response via getContent()
A credential setup comment (aicore configure) is present

evals.prompt: Give me TypeScript for text embeddings via SAP GenAI Hub using @sap-ai-sdk.
evals.expected_output: Agent produces embedding code using OrchestrationEmbeddingClient (or the LangChain embedding client) with the v2 embeddings.model.name config.
assertions: Code imports an embedding client (OrchestrationEmbeddingClient or AzureOpenAiEmbeddingClient)
Config selects an embedding model (e.g. text-embedding-3-large / text-embedding-3-small)
For OrchestrationEmbeddingClient, config uses embeddings: { model: { name } } (v2 shape)
Code calls embed()/embedQuery() and accesses the resulting vectors

evals.prompt: How do I use LangChain with SAP AI Core in TypeScript? I want the AzureOpenAiChatClient.
evals.expected_output: Agent produces @sap-ai-sdk/langchain code using AzureOpenAiChatClient with invoke/stream, and notes no LiteLLM proxy is needed.
assertions: Code imports AzureOpenAiChatClient from @sap-ai-sdk/langchain
Install command includes @sap-ai-sdk/langchain and @langchain/core
Code uses invoke() and/or stream() with a for await loop
Agent states no LiteLLM proxy is required for the LangChain integration

evals.prompt: Give me a LangChain OrchestrationClient example in TypeScript for SAP AI Core.
evals.expected_output: Agent produces @sap-ai-sdk/langchain OrchestrationClient code typed with LangChainOrchestrationModuleConfig and the v2 promptTemplating shape.
assertions: Code imports OrchestrationClient from @sap-ai-sdk/langchain
Config is typed as LangChainOrchestrationModuleConfig (not the plain OrchestrationModuleConfig from @sap-ai-sdk/orchestration)
Config uses the v2 promptTemplating.model shape
Code uses invoke() or stream()

evals.prompt: I already use the openai npm package. How do I point it at SAP AI Core from TypeScript?
evals.expected_output: Agent explains the LiteLLM proxy pattern and produces openai-package code with an overridden baseURL, and mentions the SAP SDK as the native alternative.
assertions: Code uses the openai npm package with baseURL overridden to a LiteLLM proxy URL
Agent explains a LiteLLM proxy must be running (points to FRAMEWORKS.md or setup)
Agent mentions @sap-ai-sdk as the native alternative that needs no proxy
Install command uses npm install openai

evals.prompt: Write the SAP orchestration chat code in Python for me.
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes this is a Python request and hands off to the aicore-sdk-python skill rather than generating JS/TS.
assertions: Agent does not generate TypeScript/JavaScript code
Agent explicitly hands off to or names the aicore-sdk-python skill

evals.prompt: Generate a chat example with @sap-ai-sdk/orchestration but I don't have a deployment yet.
evals.expected_output: Agent notes a deployment is needed and offers to invoke aicore-lifecycle-management, rather than silently emitting code that will fail.
assertions: Agent recognizes no deployment/model is available
Agent offers to invoke or names aicore-lifecycle-management to list/create a deployment
Agent still explains the correct v2 code shape to use once a deployment exists

evals.prompt: How do I add tool calling (function calling) to an orchestration chat in TypeScript?
evals.expected_output: Agent produces tool-calling guidance; if the context7 MCP tool is available it prefers the live docs, otherwise it uses the baked-in reference and does not fabricate the API.
assertions: Tools are configured under promptTemplating.prompt.tools (v2 shape)
For streaming, tool-call deltas are read via getDeltaToolCalls()
Agent does not invent a v1-style config; it uses the reference or Context7 for specifics
Config uses the v2 promptTemplating shape

evals.prompt: How do I mask personal data (PII) before it reaches the model, in TypeScript orchestration?
evals.expected_output: Agent explains the orchestration masking module and, if context7 is available, fetches the current shape; otherwise uses the baked-in reference pointer without fabricating.
assertions: Answer references a masking module/config on the orchestration client (e.g. masking with masking_providers)
Agent uses the v2 promptTemplating shape for the base client config
If unsure of exact masking config, agent consults Context7 (if available) or the reference rather than guessing

evals.prompt: What's the current, correct way to set the model name in the @sap-ai-sdk orchestration config? I saw an old example using model_name.
evals.expected_output: Agent states the v2 shape uses promptTemplating.model.name and that llm.model_name is the deprecated v1 shape.
assertions: Agent says the current shape is promptTemplating: { model: { name } }
Agent identifies llm: { model_name } as the old v1 shape that no longer applies
Agent does not present the v1 shape as current

evals.prompt: I want to use the standard OpenAI SDK (chat + Responses API) against SAP AI Core in TypeScript, without running a separate proxy. How?
evals.expected_output: Agent produces @sap-ai-sdk/openai code using SapOpenAi.createClient and notes it removes the need for a LiteLLM proxy.
assertions: Code imports SapOpenAi from @sap-ai-sdk/openai and calls SapOpenAi.createClient(...)
Install command includes @sap-ai-sdk/openai and the openai peer dependency
Agent states this native package does NOT require a LiteLLM proxy
Code does not set a top-level `model` field in the request body (AI Core routes via the deployment)

evals.prompt: Give me TypeScript to do retrieval-augmented generation on SAP AI Core: create a collection, add documents, and search.
evals.expected_output: Agent produces @sap-ai-sdk/document-grounding code using VectorApi/RetrievalApi with the correct executeRaw + Location-header collection-id pattern.
assertions: Code imports from @sap-ai-sdk/document-grounding (VectorApi and RetrievalApi)
createCollection uses .executeRaw() and derives the collection id from the Location response header
Every API call passes an AI-Resource-Group header
RetrievalApi.search is called with filters including dataRepositoryType and dataRepositories

evals.prompt: How do I manage versioned prompt templates in SAP AI Core from TypeScript?
evals.expected_output: Agent produces @sap-ai-sdk/prompt-registry code using PromptTemplatesApi with the fluent .execute() pattern.
assertions: Code imports PromptTemplatesApi from @sap-ai-sdk/prompt-registry
createUpdatePromptTemplate passes name, scenario, version, and spec.template
Calls end with .execute() and pass AI-Resource-Group-Scope and AI-Resource-Group headers
Install command uses npm install @sap-ai-sdk/prompt-registry

evals.prompt: I need to run thousands of prompts as an offline batch job on SAP AI Core in TypeScript. Show me how.
evals.expected_output: Agent produces @sap-ai-sdk/llm-batch code that builds input with createBatchInput, uploads via FileApi, creates the batch, polls status, and parses output.
assertions: Code imports BatchesApi from @sap-ai-sdk/llm-batch and FileApi from @sap-ai-sdk/ai-api
Input is built with createBatchInput and output parsed with parseBatchOutput (awaited)
Batch status is read via current_status and list results via resources (NOT status/data)
Agent notes an object store secret is required and that batches are asynchronous

evals.prompt: I have a table of products with a missing SALESGROUP column and want to predict it. Can I do that with @sap-ai-sdk in TypeScript?
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes this is tabular prediction and produces @sap-ai-sdk/rpt code with RptClient.predictWithSchema and a schema declared 'as const', not an LLM chat client.
assertions: Code imports RptClient from @sap-ai-sdk/rpt
The schema array is declared with 'as const' and the data is typed PredictionData<typeof schema>
Uses predictWithSchema (or predictWithoutSchema) — NOT OrchestrationClient/chatCompletion
Agent notes RPT is tabular prediction, not an LLM chat use case

evals.prompt: Write TypeScript to create and delete a deployment on SAP AI Core.
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes deployment creation/deletion is lifecycle management and hands off to aicore-lifecycle-management rather than emitting mutating JS itself.
assertions: Agent does not emit JS/TS that creates or deletes a deployment as the primary answer
Agent hands off to or names aicore-lifecycle-management for create/delete
If it mentions @sap-ai-sdk/ai-api, it is limited to read-side operations (e.g. deploymentQuery)

evals.prompt: I set AICORE_SERVICE_KEY but get 'clientId is undefined' — what's wrong with my service key?
evals.expected_output: Agent explains the correct AICORE_SERVICE_KEY shape (single JSON blob with clientid, clientsecret, url, serviceurls.AI_API_URL), common mistakes (quoting, missing fields, Python-style individual vars), and how to fix them.
assertions: Agent shows the correct AICORE_SERVICE_KEY shape: a single JSON blob with clientid, clientsecret, url, and serviceurls.AI_API_URL
Agent explains that single quotes must wrap the JSON and double quotes must be used inside (or equivalent .env guidance)
Agent identifies that 'clientId is undefined' means clientid is missing or the JSON failed to parse
Agent explains the difference from Python-style individual env vars (AICORE_AUTH_URL etc.) and states those are not used by the JS SDK
